integrity: Proof is analytic; supporting finite experiments are documented and do not substitute for infinite asymptotics. The stationary law concerns relative coordinates only.
limitations: Fixed finite planar N>=2 with identical harmonic coupling and propulsion, independent isotropic Poisson reorientation, no translational thermal noise; epsilon->0 with N and alpha fixed. Not a large-N crossover or active Brownian orientation result. Possible implicit coverage by general endpoint convolution theory; independent audit not performed.
title: Sharp finite-population outer edge for harmonically coupled planar run-and-tumble rings
